name: Aswang
speed_detail: 1.53 m/s base; fast LOS acceleration (8.67s to max)
tells: Accelerates faster on line of sight; hunt ends immediately if it reaches a player inside an official hiding spot.

name: Banshee
tells: Always female; stalks one target player and ignores others inside; 33% chance to scream on Parabolic Mic; prefers singing events.

name: Dayan
speed_detail: 2.25 m/s moving near (<=10m) / 1.2 m/s still near
tells: Always female; speeds up (2.25 m/s) when a nearby player moves within 10m and slows (1.2 m/s) when still.

name: Deildegast
speed_detail: Starts 3.0 m/s; drops 0.1 m/s per item interaction (min 0.4 m/s)
tells: Starts hunts at 3.0 m/s and slows down as items are interacted with/thrown (down to 0.4 m/s).

name: Demon
tells: Can hunt at any sanity (70% threshold); 60s smudge timer instead of 90s; crucifix range +50% per tier.

name: Deogen
tells: Always knows player location during hunts; sprints fast from afar and slows to 0.4 m/s when close.

name: Gallu
speed_detail: 1.36 m/s Weakened / 1.7 m/s Normal / 1.96 m/s Enraged
tells: Cycles Normal, Enraged (1.96 m/s, ignores salt), and Weakened (1.36 m/s) states.

name: Goryo
tells: Cannot change favorite room; D.O.T.S only shows on video camera when no players are in the ghost room.

name: Hantu
speed_detail: Up to 2.7 m/s in freezing cold / 1.4 m/s >15C
tells: Faster in cold rooms and slower in warm rooms; never turns breaker on; shows freezing breath in hunts with breaker off.

name: Jinn
tells: Speeds up to 2.5 m/s on LOS (>3m) when breaker is on; never turns breaker off directly; can drain 25% sanity at breaker.

name: Kormos
tells: Blind visual detection past ~5m; tracks player footsteps; no mist or chase events.

name: Mare
tells: Never turns lights ON; high chance to turn lights OFF immediately or burst bulbs; hunts at 60% in dark / 40% in light.

name: Moroi
speed_detail: Scales faster as average sanity drops
tells: Faster at lower sanity; Spirit Box/Parabolic Mic can curse sanity drain; blinded for ~7s by smudge instead of 5s.

name: Myling
tells: Footsteps/vocals only audible under 12m during hunts (normal 20m); frequent Parabolic Mic sounds.

name: Obake
tells: Can leave 6-fingered prints; shapeshifts during hunt blinks; 25% chance to skip UV/salt footprints.

name: Obambo
speed_detail: Slower when Calm / Faster when Aggressive
tells: Alternates between Calm and Aggressive states every 2 minutes, even mid-hunt.

name: Oni
tells: Drains 20% sanity on ghost events; stays more visible during hunt blinks; never does Ghost Mist events.

name: Onryo
tells: Lit candles/firelights act like crucifixes and block hunts; 3rd blowout triggers a hunt; can blow out same flame twice in <20s; cannot light candles.

name: Phantom
tells: Taking a photo makes it disappear and it won't show in photos; roams to players leaving EMF 2; longer invisibility during hunts.

name: Poltergeist
tells: Throws items rapidly/multiple at once during hunts and can trigger high-speed item explosions from piles.

name: Raiju
tells: Moves at 2.5 m/s near active player electronics and disrupts electronics from 15m instead of 10m.

name: Revenant
speed_detail: 1.0 m/s no target / 3.0 m/s on target detection
tells: Moves slowly at 1.0 m/s until detecting a player (LOS/sound/electronics), surging to 3.0 m/s.

name: Shade
tells: Won't hunt or do object interactions while players are in the same room; prefers Ghost Mist; never sings.

name: Spirit
tells: Smudge/incense blocks hunts for 180s instead of the standard 90s.

name: Thaye
speed_detail: Fast when young -> Slow when aged
tells: Starts fast and active, then slows down and becomes less active as it ages near players; no LOS speed boost.

name: The Mimic
tells: Always shows Ghost Orbs (even on 0-evidence runs) and mimics abilities/speeds of other ghosts.

name: The Twins
speed_detail: Slower twin (~1.5 m/s) / Faster twin (~1.9 m/s)
tells: Can perform close and long-range interactions back-to-back; hunts alternate between slower and faster speeds.

name: Wraith
tells: Never steps in or disturbs salt piles (and ignores Tier 3 salt slowdown); can teleport to players leaving EMF 2.

name: Yokai
tells: Talking near it can trigger hunts up to ~80% sanity; short detection/hearing range (~2.5m) during hunts.

name: Yurei
tells: Can fully close doors (including exit/front doors); smudge traps it in its room for ~90s.
